summary: Frontend-only verification of Dashboard (Command Center) updates. Confirmed (1) new war-room-scene-v4-1.jpg loads as Dashboard background with HTTP 200 and knights visibly positioned behind the castle wall (upper body visible above battlements), (2) Navbar is fully removed from /dashboard (no <nav>, no Operations/Pricing/Logout links), (3) HolographicGridFloor renders with pointer-events:none, (4) Navbar still works correctly on /pricing and /war-room (regression intact), (5) end-to-end login flow works (login API -> /dashboard), (6) no console/network errors. Tested on both desktop (1280x800) and mobile (390x844).
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx imports several heavy modules (TacticalGameMap, @phosphor-icons/react variants, tutorials data) that are not used in the current Layer-1-only render. Once layers 2+ start mounting they will be needed, but for now these unused imports inflate the dashboard bundle. Consider deferring imports until Layer 2 lands.

Two unused fetches still run on Dashboard mount (api.get('/games'), api.get('/user/onboarding')) and their results (games, onboarding state) are never rendered in the current minimal scene. Harmless for now; either keep them as pre-warm cache or remove until Layer 2.

Auth screen UX quirk noticed during testing: opening /auth, then filling email+password and clicking JOIN does NOT call /api/auth/login on the very first attempt for an existing user — clicking the 'ENLIST →' toggle once first is required before JOIN triggers /api/auth/login. After that, it works. This is outside the current review scope (not a Dashboard bug) but is worth a follow-up: the default mode of the auth form may be 'register' even though the heading reads 'RECRUITMENT', causing existing users a moment of confusion. Recommend explicitly distinguishing LOGIN vs ENLIST modes (e.g., heading + button text both change), or making the form auto-fallback to /api/auth/login if /api/auth/register returns 'user exists'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard is intentionally Layer-1 only: background scene (war-room-scene-v4-1.jpg) + HolographicGridFloor + one-time CypherIntroBriefing overlay. No widgets, no game tiles, no hub, no quota. This is BY DESIGN. Do NOT flag missing dashboard UI as bugs. AUTH FORM: to reliably login an existing user via Playwright, click the 'ENLIST →' toggle ONCE before filling and clicking JOIN; otherwise the form may stay in register-mode and the click is a no-op. Also set localStorage['ta-cypher-intro-seen']='1' before/after login to bypass the CypherIntroBriefing overlay on /dashboard.
